quotes.q: They say that the best blaze burns brightest when circumstances are at their worst.
I'd rather be a pig than a fascist.
A pig that doesn't fly is just a pig.
The wind is rising! We must try to live!
Once you've met someone, you never really forget them.
You cannot alter your fate. However, you can rise to meet it.
To see with eyes unclouded by hate.
We each need to find our own inspiration, Kiki. Sometimes it's not easy.
It's not really important what color your dress is. What matters is the heart inside.
Whenever someone creates something with all of their heart, then that creation is given a soul.
Everybody, try laughing. Then whatever scares you will go away.
Trees and people used to be good friends.
Why do fireflies have to die so soon?
Sometimes you have to stand up and fight for the things that are worth fighting for.
